posts.name: TheJayMann
posts.cooked:
Pydro:
  1. It is all from 1 attack though. not multiple attacks. Even if an attack does 0 damage, it would still use it up.

Actually, if something does damage which ends up with a total of 0 (or less) then no damage is taken, thus it doesn't qualify as next damage (thus an attack of 0 will not remove stealth protection)

However, irreducible damage would use up the protection, with none of the benifets of the protection.

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked:
Considering it is reduction, I would think it would go away even if the thing causing Wraith damage were somehow reduced to 0 by another means. As damage reduction and increases happen "simultaneously" it would end up being in order of play if anything. Considering Wraith's character card has probably been in play the longest, her damage reduction will surely kick in before any other damage reduction.

However I am not so sure about Immunity.
